args.summary:
Model built and verified successfully (generate_model ok, all L1/L2/L3 checks passed).

Structure: cast-in-place prestressed concrete continuous single-cell box girder, 4 spans 32+45+45+32 m (bearing centre-to-centre), modelled as a 2D spine beam (structure.idealization = spine_beam_2d) on a continuous_on_piers system, since pier column geometry is given.

Section/material: cast_box 2.2 m deep, B_top 12.5 m, B_bot 6.5 m; integration gave A = 6.885 m^2, I = 4.5589 m^4. C50 concrete, Ec = 34500 MPa; owner-specified gamma = 26.5 kN/m^3 (overriding the 26.0 code default, MR-00) → w = 182.4525 kN/m, m = 18.5986 t/m (self-weight of girders only).

Supports: all five lines have laminated elastomeric bearings, two per line. Abutments 0/4 and Piers 1/3 are PTFE sliding (longitudinal free, Kh = 0); Pier 2 is plain (fixed, longitudinal shear spring Kh = 10909.1 kN/m). Bearings modelled as vertical springs (Kv from JTG 3362-2018 8.7, Ge = 1.0 MPa): Kv = 3.14e6 (abutments), 7.18e6 (Piers 1/3), 8.03e6 kN/m (Pier 2); shape factors S = 10.10, 13.54, 14.69. Rotation free.

Piers: twin circular columns D = 1.4 m, C40 (Ec = 32500 MPa), merged to A = 3.07876 m^2, I = 0.377148 m^4, base fixed; lengths 6/10/19 m for Piers 1/2/3.

Live load (JTG D60-2015, Class I, one-way): 3 lanes, xi = 0.78, qk = 10.5 kN/m; Pk = 324 kN (32 m spans) and 350 kN (45 m spans).

Results: first vertical bending frequency f1 = 2.686 Hz (impact factor mu = 0.1589). Self-weight support reactions ≈ 2076 / 7739 / 8476 / 7721 / 2086 kN (ends to ends); self-weight hogging moments at the three interior supports ≈ -26991 / -32802 / -26664 kNm. Under lane load the maximum positive moment is 11420 kNm (interior span) and maximum negative moment -9501 kNm.
